mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 52 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a New Moon, with an overnight low of 39 degrees and no rain expected.

Regarding city infrastructure, the Mark Drive Reconstruction project is currently in Phase 2. Contractors are busy finishing concrete curbs and sidewalks, with the next layer of asphalt expected to be laid before winter weather sets in, while final landscaping and the top layer of asphalt are slated for next spring.

We have plenty to look forward to in Verona. You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, the town comes alive with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, we highlight an incident from October 25 where officers located a 40-year-old man asleep at the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an O W I arrest.
If you are craving a treat, Culver's is open tonight until 10:00 PM. Stop by to enjoy today's Flavor of the Day while the shop is still serving.
